newsitem.title: UK: UK Feb global trade deficit 758 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: UK Feb global trade deficit 758 mln stg.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics issued the following data on Britain's global trade in February (in million stg, previously announced data in brackets)
TRADE VALUE EX OIL/ERRATICS Feb Jan
Economists had forecast a February deficit of 813 million stg.
The ONS said the erratic pattern of the deficit makes
the estimation of trend difficult. But bearing this in mind the latest estimate of trend suggests the whole world goods deficit is narrowing.
It said latest estimates of trend in the value of trend show
exports rising slightly and imports flat.
Provisional estimates for February show export and import prices little changed from January, the ONS said.

On a three-month basis, exports of all main commodity groups showed a rise in volume apart from basic materials. Within finished manufactures, exports of capital goods rose 3.5 percent and intermediate goods rose 3.0 percent.
For imports, all the main commodity groups except fuels showed a rise in volume. Within finished manufactures, capital goods rose 5.0 percent, the ONS said.
